purpose: Provide a whole-Lab temporal projection that preserves multiple institutional tracks, cross-track convergence, state reconstruction, and provenance gaps instead of flattening history into one founder chronology.
provenanceNote: Seed chronology only. Events preserve evidence posture and source references; empty tracks are visible rather than filled by inference.

snapshots.note: A physical research environment functions as a persistent external context window.

snapshots.label: April 2026 · Representation program
snapshots.note: Volumology is explicitly reframed toward a broader representational-gauge program.

snapshots.label: July 2026 · Schema construction
snapshots.note: Schemathematics crystallizes as a bounded construction and transformation program.

snapshots.label: August 1 · Second-order method
snapshots.note: The long-run research genealogy and agentic scientific method are joined into a dated synthesis package.

events.title: Attempted external scrutiny of relativistic work
events.summary: Origin materials record outreach seeking criticism of an attempted relativistic derivation or extension.
events.consequence: The research program is explicitly subjected to an external criticism boundary rather than remaining entirely private.

events.title: Physical research-room phase
events.summary: A dedicated room functions as an external cognitive apparatus that keeps multiple research branches spatially persistent and mutually inspectable.
events.consequence: Research representation becomes environmental: the room itself acts as working memory and comparison machinery.

events.title: Volumology archive mapped as historical program
events.summary: The surviving archive is treated as historical provenance around region, boundary, interface, recursion, operators, and formal-to-executable evidence attempts.
events.consequence: Earlier work is preserved as lineage without inheriting its strongest historical claims as current authority.

events.title: Volumology reframed as representational gauge work
events.summary: A retained checkpoint characterizes the earlier program as bounded observable structure under distinction, gauge, interface, representation, invariant, and defect.
events.consequence: The research target moves from a domain-specific volume program toward lawful representation change.

events.title: Schemathematics crystallizes
events.summary: Schemas are differentiated as bounded representational forms carrying typed slots, relations, admissibility conditions, invariants, transformations, validation, defects, and repair.
events.consequence: Construction and transformation of representations becomes a first-class research program rather than an implicit technique.

events.title: Second-Order Scientific Method origin package
events.summary: A dated synthesis joins the long-run physics problem, primitive representational questions, agentic pressure on fixed possibility spaces, Distinction Space, Contexture, proto-schema work, and a second-order scientific method.
events.consequence: The Lab acquires an explicit methodological layer for instrumenting research processes themselves.

events.title: Schemathematics → Representational Mechanics edge retained
events.summary: The earliest retained checkpoint records Schemathematics as supplying representational machinery to Representational Mechanics.
events.consequence: The distinction between the construction program and the applying/study discipline becomes historically inspectable.

events.title: Current Boundary Theory architecture becomes source-controlled
events.summary: Repository reconciliation records Boundary Theory centered on Distinction Space, typed operational facets, Contexture as composable subspace, and Representational Mechanics with Formal Grammars, Boundary First, and Corpus Forge.
events.consequence: The current conceptual architecture receives an explicit controlled representation against which later changes can be compared.

events.title: Augusta founder lineage captured in repository
events.summary: The internal founder-history package records an institutional causal spine from Augusta formation through technical intensification, professional discontinuity, independent research and systems practice, reconstruction, and capability building.
events.consequence: Founder history becomes typed institutional provenance rather than informal biography alone.

events.title: Volumology correction becomes public provenance artifact
events.summary: Historical Volumology material is reframed as provenance to preserve with correction rather than delete or inherit uncritically.
events.consequence: The publication boundary demonstrates a repair rule: preserve chronology and error while separating both from current claim authority.

events.title: Master founder and intellectual chronology reconstructed
events.summary: Founder, research, terminology, theory architecture, and institutional histories are joined into one typed chronology while unresolved provenance gaps remain visible.
events.consequence: The Lab gains a temporal control object capable of supporting later whole-institution projections.

events.title: Physical Lab Machine adopts production card grammar
events.summary: The web prototype renders institutional subsystems as a connected physical apparatus while retaining graph-derived boundaries, ports, state, and relations.
events.consequence: Institutional topology becomes directly inspectable as a visual-operational object rather than remaining an abstract sitemap.
events.sourceRef: web commit 31197e76 · refactor(bfux): use production card skin in physical machine

events.title: Lab Machine second-layer content contract introduced
events.summary: Subsystem cards gain structured content for institutional role, boundary, process, rationale, validation, projections, and takeaway.
events.consequence: The middle scale of the website begins explaining why each subsystem exists and how it behaves instead of merely linking to contained artifacts.
